title: Film
description: This is a JSON schema for the film data structure

id.description: Unique identifier of the film data structure in the Film Manager platform

owner.description: The id of the film data structure owner, i.e., the user who created it

private.description: Set to true if the film data structure is marked as private, false if it is public

watchDate.description: The date when the film was watched by the owner (YYYY-MM-DD)

rating.description: Non-negative integer number (maximum 10) expressing the rating the owner has given to the film

favorite.description: Set to true if that film is among the favourite ones of the user, false otherwise
